elements_selected.content: Migrate src/web/ws.rs's initial-sync and op messages from automerge bytes (base64) to diamond-types bytes (base64). Update CrdtDocEntry to hold a Box<dyn CrdtBackend>. Replace the automerge::ScalarValue conversion in json_to_scalar with a project-owned Scalar enum (defined in src/crdt/marks.rs) so the ws module no longer imports automerge::*. Update existing ws.rs tests to use the new wire shape. WAL format change is acceptable — clear .zetl/wal/ on first run after the swap (documented in commit message).
